title: 2021 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Metal Ox
seo_title: 2021 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Metal Ox (12 February – 31 January 2022)
description: 2021 is the Year of the Metal Ox (Yin, Xin-chou), from 12 February 2021 to 31 January 2022. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 2021.
lead: Born in 2021? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Ox, but check the date: the 2021 Metal Ox year began on 12 February 2021. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 2021: Year of the Metal Ox, from 12 February 2021 to 31 January 2022.

image.caption: Illustration from MyBirthSign's zodiac artwork; it is not a photograph.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 2021 was the Year of the Ox. It began with Lunar New Year on 12 February 2021 and ended on 31 January 2022, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 2021 ends in 1, which makes it a Metal year, and as an odd year it is Yin. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 2021 is a Xin-chou year. The same Metal Ox combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1961 before it and 2081 after it.
Lunar New Year 2021 fell on 12 February 2021, so everyone born in January 2021, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Rat.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Ox guide describes the sign like this: “Reliable, honest, and hard-working. Oxen build success slowly and steadily through persistence.” The usual watch-out: “Can be stubborn and slow to adapt to sudden change.”

The Metal element adds its own flavour. Metal years bring discipline, ambition, and strong will. People of this element tend to be determined, independent, and value-driven. Read more in our Metal element guide, or the full Year of the Ox page.
Careers often linked with the Ox: agriculture, engineering, finance, medicine.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 2021
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Ox's best matches are the Rat, Snake and Rooster, and its clash sign is the Goat, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Ox, it has no special traditional relationship with the Horse, so 2026 is a neutral year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Ox, it sits directly opposite the Goat, so 2027 is its clash year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Ox years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1997 (Fire Ox); 2009 (Earth Ox); 2033 (Water Ox). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 2021 is the Year of the Ox, a Yin Metal Ox year (Xin-chou).
When does the 2021 Year of the Ox start and end?
It starts on 12 February 2021 and ends on 31 January 2022.
I was born in January 2021. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Rat: Lunar New Year 2021 was on 12 February 2021, so all of January 2021 belongs to the Rat year.
Metal. 2021 ends in 1, which belongs to Metal, and it is a Yin year.
Who is the Ox compatible with?
Traditionally the Rat, Snake and Rooster. The Ox's clash sign is the Goat.
